actions.name: Banks
actions.help:
Create a Bank

Banks are the financial institutions at which you and your contacts have their accounts.

actions.name: Bank Accounts
actions.help:
Create a Bank Account

From here you can manage all bank accounts linked to you and your contacts.

actions.name: Bank Statements
actions.help:
Register a bank statement

A bank statement is a summary of all financial transactions occurring over a given period of time on a bank account. You should receive this periodically from your bank.

Odoo allows you to reconcile a statement line directly with the related sale or purchase invoices.

actions.name: Cash Registers
actions.help:
Create a new cash log

A Cash Register allows you to manage cash entries in your cash journals. This feature provides an easy way to follow up cash payments on a daily basis.

actions.name: account.bank.statement
actions.help:
This is your new action.

By default, it contains a list and a form view and possibly other view types depending on the options you chose for your model.

You can start customizing these screens by clicking on the Studio icon on the top right corner (you can also customize this help message there).

views.name: res.bank.form
res.bank.tree
views.arch:
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<tree string="Banks">
                    <field name="name"/>
                    <field name="bic"/>
                    <field name="country"/>
                </tree>

views.name: res.bank.view.search
views.arch:
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<search string="Search Bank">
                    <field name="name"/>
                    <separator/>
                    <filter string="Archived" name="inactive" domain="[('active', '=', False)]"/>
                </search>

views.name: res.partner.bank.form
views.arch:
<form string="Bank account" name="bank_account_form">
                <sheet>
                    <widget name="web_ribbon" title="Archived" bg_color="text-bg-danger" invisible="active"/>
                    <group>
                        <group>
                            <field name="sequence" invisible="1"/>
                            <field name="acc_type" invisible="1"/>
                            <field name="acc_number"/>
                            <field name="bank_id"/>
                            <field name="acc_holder_name"/>
                            <field name="partner_id"/>
                        </group>
                        <group>
                            <field name="company_id" groups="base.group_multi_company" options="{'no_create': True}"/>
                            <field name="currency_id" groups="base.group_multi_currency" options="{'no_create': True}"/>
                            <field name="allow_out_payment" widget="boolean_toggle"/>
                            <field name="active" invisible="1"/>
                        </group>
                    </group>
                </sheet>
                </form>

views.name: res.partner.bank.tree
views.arch:
<tree string="Bank Accounts" multi_edit="1">
                    <field name="sequence" widget="handle"/>
                    <field name="acc_number"/>
                    <field name="bank_name" string="Bank"/>
                    <field name="company_id" groups="base.group_multi_company"/>
                    <field name="partner_id"/>
                    <field name="acc_holder_name" column_invisible="True"/>
                    <field name="allow_out_payment" widget="boolean_toggle"/>
                </tree>

views.name: res.partner.bank.search
views.arch:
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<search string="Bank Accounts">
                    <field name="bank_name" filter_domain="['|', ('bank_name','ilike',self), ('acc_number','ilike',self)]" string="Bank Name"/>
                    <field name="company_id" invisible="context.get('company_hide', True)"/>
                    <field name="partner_id"/>
                </search>

views.name: account.online.sync.res.partner.bank.setup.form
views.arch: Leave empty to create a new journal for this bank account, or select a journal to link it with the bank account.

views.name: account.bank.statement.tree
views.arch:
<tree decoration-danger="journal_id and not is_complete or not is_valid" decoration-muted="not journal_id" create="false" string="Statements">
                    <field name="name"/>
                    <field name="date"/>
                    <field name="journal_id"/>
                    <field name="company_id" groups="base.group_multi_company"/>
                    <field name="balance_start"/>
                    <field name="balance_end_real"/>
                    <field name="balance_end" column_invisible="True"/>
                    <field name="currency_id" column_invisible="True"/>
                    <field name="is_complete" column_invisible="True"/>
                    <field name="is_valid" column_invisible="True"/>
                </tree>

views.name: account.bank.statement.search
views.arch:
<search string="Search Bank Statements">
                    <field name="name" string="Bank Statement"/>
                    <field name="date"/>
                    <filter string="Empty" name="empty" domain="[('line_ids','=',False)]"/>
                    <filter name="invalid" string="Invalid" domain="['|', ('is_valid', '=', False),('is_complete', '=', False)]"/>
                    <separator/>
                    <filter name="filter_date" date="date"/>
                    <field name="journal_id" domain="[('type', 'in', ('bank', 'cash'))]"/>
